operatorProperties.code:
def process(waterBodyTesting2023, ejPopulations):
    import pandas as pd

    w = waterBodyTesting2023.copy()
    ej = ejPopulations.copy()

    # --- Filter to marine beach samples in 2023 (already 2023) ---
    w = w[w["Beach Type Description"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().eq("marine")].copy()

    # --- Normalize join keys (community/municipality names) ---
    w["_muni"] = (
        w["Community"].astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True)
        .str.lower()
    )
    ej["_muni"] = (
        ej["Municipality"].astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True)
        .str.lower()
    )

    # Use percent of population in EJ block groups as the EJ population share measure
    ejShareCol = "Percent of population in EJ BGs"
    ej = ej[["_muni", ejShareCol]].copy()

    merged = w.merge(ej, on="_muni", how="left", validate="m:1")

    # --- Define exceedance from Violation column ---
    merged["_exceed"] = merged["Violation"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().eq("yes")

    # --- Compute exceedance rates for EJ>50% and EJ<25% ---
    hi = merged[merged[ejShareCol] > 50]
    lo = merged[merged[ejShareCol] < 25]

    hiRate = hi["_exceed"].mean()
    loRate = lo["_exceed"].mean()

    diff = hiRate - loRate

    return pd.DataFrame(
        [{
            "hiRate": hiRate,
            "loRate": loRate,
            "difference": diff,
            "differenceRounded2": round(diff, 2),
            "hiN": int(len(hi)),
            "loN": int(len(lo)),
            "unmatchedN": int(merged[ejShareCol].isna().sum())
        }]
    )
